changelog:
- Initial release of local-config-model-recommender.
- Dynamically reads user’s OpenCLAW configuration to list available models.
- Recommends optimal AI models based on keyword pattern matching aligned to task requirements.
- Supports a wide range of both global and domestic models including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, Qwen, and MiniMax.
- Covers multimodal, code generation, advanced reasoning, premium tier, and lightweight models for various needs.
- Ensures recommendations are tailored to models actually available in your configuration.
